notes.title: Game Update V2021.04.29
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38846662/cc593e5e0385d09c8d485bb2051805c97bea9864.png[/img]

Hello there!

This is the biggest Hinge update since the release. This update includes 3 new endings and more.
We have reworked the game in detail and made it more understandable for you. We listened carefully to your feedback. You no longer have to record music with a phonograph several times - now only 1 time is enough. Now the protagonist writes hints in his notebook as if it is his own thoughts.

[b]Update V2021.04.29:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new endings
[*] Added notebook with objectives & hints
[*] Added few more objectives
[*] Added nausea reduction in the game menu
[*] Now tuning fork detects monsters
[*] Phonograph records music that is not erased after death
[*] Added a wristwatch to determine the cycle time of the main character
[*] Locations in the maze are cut off after visiting them
[*] Added a hint that explains how the cycle works
[*] Motion blur is disabled by default
[*] Added a sound volume setting to the menu
[*] Added lighting for gameplay objects, which works when volumetric light is off
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update V2021.03.25
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38846662/bcd7ee4beff6cdc8d0e1ff1ba0ea0925c4f4e354.jpg[/img]

Hello there!

This week we are getting rid of blurriness and managing to improve image quality. Update V2021.03.25 adds more precise tools to adjust the graphics settings. Also, we added a fog which appears when the volumetric light is disabled. Now when you turn off the volumetric light in the menu settings - the picture does not get darker. 

[b]Update V2021.03.25:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added slider for more precise resolution adjustment
[*] Added sharpen setting
[*] Added fog that turns on when the volumetric light is turned off, which makes the game experience more comfortable
[*] Added more fine tuning of volumetric light quality
[*] Fixed bug with endings
[*] Added phonograph's manual
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38846662/371ae8f3ca8be0c04ea87982fee5616b2102c2a5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38846662/d59ffe2c0db747f3ec7452efd030d6146f5dce46.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Update V2021.02.01
notes.notes:
Hello there!

2 months we've been fighting with inability to implement a resolution settings into the game and now we made it. Adjusting the resolution settings can improve FPS performance up to 90 for most of PC configurations. At the same time we will keep fixing the bugs you encounter and will release the next update in a week.

Game Update V2021.02.01:
[list]
[*] Improved FPS performance 
[*] Added resolution as a menu settings option
[*] Improved physics based interactions
[*] Improved storyline
[*] Added tuning fork illumination
[*] Added new kind of monsters
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and support. 
[previewyoutube=tzVQr7PyKmc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hinge's next big update and discount
notes.notes:
We have 2 good news for you:
1) On February 1 we gonna release the performance optimization patch wich allows you to achieve 90 fps on most specs. We are proud to announce that after 2 months of hard work we succeeded in performance optimization. 
2) Now you still can save 25% on Hinge, but the offer ends in less than 2 days.
